card.name: Inside unusual proper names
card.fires_on: Short pieces in the middle of rare or foreign proper names, such as Native American words, romanized names and surnames. Examples are 'ish' in Kishiwu and 'i' in Kitchi Gami.

modes.label: Native American terms
modes.description: Syllables inside Pawnee, Ojibwa or similar place and group names.

modes.label: Personal names
modes.description: Middle syllables of author or person surnames and romanized Chinese names.
